description: The Speckle Polarimeter (SPP) is a facility instrument combining a two-beam polarimeter and speckle interferometer on the 2.5-m telescope of CMO SAI MSU, equipped with intermediate/narrow-band and standard filters (550nm, 625nm, 656nm, 880nm, V, Rc, Ic) for high-resolution polarimetric imaging.
short_description: SAI MSU Speckle Polarimeter (SPP) filters, CMO 2.5-m telescope
facility_description: The Caucasian Mountain Observatory (CMO) is a mountain observatory of the Sternberg Astronomical Institute, Lomonosov Moscow State University (SAI MSU), located on the Mount Shatdzhatmaz plateau in Russia.
notes: SPP operates on the 2.5-m telescope at CMO SAI MSU. No explicit data redistribution terms or user acknowledgement requests were found on the instrument pages or SAI website.
